frozen_expectations: Each raw-byte case carries a complete static expected projection independent of either evaluator.
boundary_notes: M01-M21 freeze grouping, exact counts, permutation invariance, ASCII output order, key and digest syntax, and 64/65 declaration limits.
M22-M38 freeze shape and closed validation/parser precedence, including escaped decoded-key duplicates and parse-before-duplicate behavior.
M39-M51 freeze BOM, UTF-8, trailing and truncated input, post-parse Unicode, depth 16/17/extreme bounds, safe integer policy, and document size.
